classification.runtimeFamily: web: static marketing page with a script-rendered shell (React Router SSR for our own site)

thickness.evidence: Hairline borders and one-pixel rules carry the structure; the measured borders are white at low coverage (53-54%), not blocks.

occlusion.evidence: The page is flat UI: nothing overlaps another element in depth.

contactShadows.evidence: No drop shadows were measured; separation comes from value steps between #1a1a1a, #3b3b3b and the ground.

bevelHighlights.evidence: No gradients or bevels on the measured panels; the surfaces are flat fills.

perspectiveConvergence.evidence: A screen-space page: nothing converges in perspective.

depthOfField.evidence: Everything on the page is equally sharp.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-14: 「我们还是用二次元公司，用明日方舟的设计方式和配色」「你给我一个静态稿子没问题」. The reference is 明日方舟 / Arknights, and the owner accepted the static mockup before implementation.

downgrade.evidence: The owner asked for the Arknights design language and palette, not a copy of its site; nothing was downgraded.

regions.contents: 站名与主导航：深底上的冷蓝字标，一行频道
时间轴：左侧 64px 时刻栏 + 发丝线轨道 + 卡片栏（1fr）
筛选：频道一行、类别一行，各自可横向滚动

regions.finding: The reference's masthead is a hairline-separated cold-blue wordmark; ours is a 40 px square mark on the rail with a single accent rule.
A continuous rule with a square marker per item is the reference's structure; ours keeps the 64 px instrument column and the 7 px square dot.
The reference separates navigation from content by hairlines, not by filled pills; our two filter rows keep square tabs on the hairline ground.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-14: 「我们还是用二次元公司，用明日方舟的设计方式和配色」「你给我一个静态稿子没问题」. The mockup was rendered from the live feed and shown for sign-off.
